items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 13 August 2026 7:01am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry and mostly sunny. Risk of coastal mist/fog patches developing in the afternoon and evening. Then some light rain or showers possible overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 24°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

8


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 5-15, occasionally variable 10 or less, veering W or NW 10-15 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in any mist and very poor in any fog patches. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Mainly dry and cloudy start, with sunny spells soon developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-1


##Wind Speed##

13


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

W or NW 10-15 occasionally 20 in places at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any rain at first. Occasional Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.

0

12

NW

##Comments##

##Sunday, 16 August 2026##

Mainly dry and rather cloudy during the day. Cloud thickening later, with rain arriving overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4, mainly later.


##Wind Speed##

11


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any rain. Hill fog developing later.


##Comments##

##Monday, 17 August 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain, possibly heavy at times.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

NW

##Visibility##

##Comments##

Strong winds for a time. Rainfall timing and amounts remain uncertain at this stage.
